{"action": "ask", "slot": "device" | "symptom" | "trigger" | "damage" | "backup", "question": "<one short question for the customer>"}

{"action": "escalate", "reason": "physical_damage" | "safety" | "billing" | "human_request", "reply": "<short reply>"}
